title: Volcanoes of Philippines (streak)
intro: 10 volcanoes of Philippines, one after another. Three markers too far from the place end the run, so aim with care. The map shows coasts, rivers, lakes and borders, and you work inside this area.

rounds.name: Laguna Caldera
rounds.fact: Laguna Caldera is a volcano with a recorded summit elevation of 743 m in the source data. The data places it in Philippines.

rounds.name: Taal
rounds.fact: Taal is a stratovolcano; the latest significant eruption recorded for it in the source data was in 2020. The data places it in Philippines.
